data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding increased from GBP 12.683m at the opening balance to reflect a gross strengthening (increase) in prior year provisions of GBP 3.248m (25.6% of opening gross claims outstanding). The movement is reported in the Technical Provisions note as "Change in prior year provisions" and reflects adverse development on prior years.
raw_causal_phrases: In setting claims provisions, the Syndicate gives consideration to the probability and magnitude of future experience being more adverse than assumed and exercises a degree of caution in setting reserves where there is considerable uncertainty.
The provision for claims outstanding comprises the estimated cost of settling all claims incurred but unpaid at the balance sheet date, whether reported or not.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Technical provisions - Claims outstanding) prior year column. Prior year development taken from Technical Provisions note row 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross column). No explicit narrative sentence explaining the drivers of the prior year movement was provided beyond the table entry and general reserving discussion; no specific named loss events or per-line reserve movements were quantified. Claims development triangle present (gross) and used for cross-checking; amounts in triangle are presented in thousands.
